# Get Article Detail

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Gets a detail about the given article.

## Syntax

~~~~text
articleDetail(detail: <#Enumeration (WFContentItemPropertyName)#>, article: <#Variable (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
articleDetail(detail: Title, article: ShortcutInput)
~~~~
